source64.label: Source / 64-bit
source64.description: Uses the current successful parsed checkpoint directly. Zero image-generation calls.
source64.prompt: Use the canonical current asset set exactly as provided. Preserve frame order, identity, layout and style.

ps2.label: PlayStation 2 Era
ps2.description: Reinterpret the same asset structure as an early-2000s PS2 action brawler.
ps2.prompt: Re-render the canonical asset in an early-2000s PlayStation 2 era action-game style. Preserve exact pose order, character identity, silhouette, landmark placement and gameplay readability. Add era-appropriate 3D-like shading, gritty materials and baked-lighting feel.

hdremaster.label: HD Remaster
hdremaster.description: Keeps the same poses and layout but sharpens everything into a clean HD remaster.
hdremaster.prompt: Re-render the canonical asset as a faithful HD remaster. Preserve exact pose order, character identity, silhouette, landmark placement, environment composition and gameplay readability. Improve edge quality, material detail, clean shadows, and effects without redesigning the content.

modernStylized.label: Modern Stylized PC
modernStylized.prompt: Re-render the canonical asset as a contemporary high-end stylized PC action game. Preserve exact pose order, frame layout, identity, silhouette, side-on camera and landmarks. Add advanced lighting, stylized materials, atmosphere and modern game-ready polish without becoming photorealistic.

modernReal.label: Modern Realistic PC
modernReal.description: Modern high-fidelity realistic version while preserving exact game structure.
modernReal.prompt: Re-render the canonical asset as a modern realistic PC action game. Preserve exact pose order, frame layout, identity, silhouette, camera and landmark placement. Add realistic materials, physically-plausible lighting, atmospheric depth and high-fidelity rendering while keeping gameplay readability.
